formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO-LiX (X = CF3SO3-, ClO4-, and AsF6-) systems have been characterized by x-ray diffraction and optical microscopy, and the resulting phase diagrams are taken into account for the interpretation of ac impedance measurements.
formulations.Notes: The high molecular weight (900 K) PEO was supplied by Aldrich. It was dried under partial vacuum, < 5 mm/Hg argon at 45°-50°C for ≈ 48h. The following lithium salts were recrystallized in acetonitrile then dried under partial vacuum for ≈ 48h at the temperatures specified: LiCF3SO3 (Pennwalt), 100°-110°C, LiAsF6 (USS), 140°-150°C, LiClO4 (Alfa), 100°-110°C.
